# Carlos Rendón

> AI proposes, the human decides. Carlos Rendón is an AI engineer for regulated enterprise platforms, based in Brisbane, Australia (remote or hybrid). Twenty years building software; since 2020 Salesforce and OmniStudio for health, government and insurance; now applied-AI tools and agents where a person stays in charge. He is also a writer of transmedia fiction and an AI-assisted music producer. Bilingual: English and Spanish. Available for contracts now.

Contact: carlos.rendon.duque@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/carlosrendonduque/ · https://github.com/carlosrendonduque

## Hire or engage
- [Work](https://carlosrendon.co/en/work/): enterprise case studies (a national counselling platform, a state police service online reporting and a government services contractor, an insurer), experience and 8 Salesforce certifications.
- [CV](https://carlosrendon.co/en/cv/): full curriculum vitae.
- [Consulting](https://carlosrendon.co/en/consulting/): free 30-minute "unoffice hours", a fixed-price AI & Salesforce readiness review (AUD 2,500, two weeks), and scoped build and integration work.

## Applied AI
- [Lab](https://carlosrendon.co/en/lab/): WorkBrain (MCP server with hybrid retrieval and per-client isolation, in daily use), Bayzara (human-in-the-loop control layer for AI agents, prototype), Conato (multi-model writing editor where the model only proposes), dataset-preflight (open-source check of a data report against its dataset), calamus and tonotopia (open-source narrative reader and sound engine).

## Art
- [Art](https://carlosrendon.co/en/art/): Toma 1024 (transmedia Master's thesis, in development), Nullheim, Fragmentado and Parallax Story (interactive fiction), and music produced with AI in the chain (project: Koombia Mate).
